_comment: Built-in sampler content + convolution impulse responses for the CDJ-3000
NOTHING here is committed to this repository. scripts/download-samples.sh
fetches each pack into SampleLibrary/downloads/ (git-ignored), the same
pattern as scripts/download-fixtures.sh. An app that ships PAE curates its
own subset from these and records attribution per SAMPLES-NOTICE.md.
License policy mirrors the codec / stem-model policy: CC0 is preferred;
CC-BY-4.0 is acceptable for a data pack WITH a per-file attribution
manifest; anything with a Non-Commercial (NC) clause is DISQUALIFIED for a
